technology_name: Biochar from Bamboo Waste: Sustainable Carbon Sequestration Solution
problem_solved: Accumulation of unmanaged bamboo biomass waste alongside degraded soil health and the critical need for scalable carbon capture methods.
description: A sustainable production framework established at KFRI's Field Research Centre in Palappilly that converts bamboo waste into biochar. This stable, carbon-rich material is created through the pyrolysis of biomass under oxygen-limited conditions. The resulting porous substance enhances soil structure, boosts microbial dynamics, and acts as a long-term terrestrial carbon sink that safely locks away carbon for hundreds to thousands of years.
applications:
• Commercial production of organic soil amendments and soil fertility boosters

• Integration into waste-to-resource programs for agricultural or forestry residues

• Generation of high-permanence carbon removal credits for compliance and voluntary markets

• Implementation in large-scale land restoration and degraded site remediation projects
